news.title:

It detected 2M malicious senders/URLs, preventing ~$500B losses with 99% efficacy in milliseconds.

news.title:
Tanla Platforms conducted a Q3 FY26 earnings call, highlighting growth in enterprise SMS and OTT communication volumes, driven by new customer additions and profitable route focus.

news.title:
Tanla Platforms' EPS grew 49% annually over five years, but its share price fell 38%. Revenue increased 12% annually.
Despite a 5-year TSR of 34%, shareholders lost 24% in the past year, underperforming the market's 7.6% gain.
